about: Phase 2 bench cases (docs/roadmap.md). Plans, hand-computed engine facts, scenes and what to look for. The bench runs the real prompts on these.

step.title: The rat plan, as written
step.plan: Fern turns into a rat, gets the keys, brings them to me, I let everyone out, we go.

stances.text: We take the miner with us.
I won't help kill anyone who doesn't need killing.

step.look_for: A literal translation: no timing, no waits, no conditions. The hole stays in.

step.title: The rat plan, with the player's timing
step.plan: Do it on his drinks. Fern changes in her back corner while he's at the cask and goes down the gutter. When he sits back down, she and the rats lift the ring off the peg behind him, and Brannoc pays them with his crusts. On his next drink they carry it to Lyra, and Fern chews through the drumhead. Lyra lets us all out, Brannoc too.

stances.text: We take the miner with us.
I won't help kill anyone who doesn't need killing.

step.look_for: Exactly the player's three timings (his drink, his sit, his next drink), nothing added.

step.title: Bench-nail lockpick
step.plan: While Snag is at the cask, I pry a nail out of the bench. The next time he's at the cask, I pick my lock with it.

stances.text: We take the miner with us.
I won't help kill anyone who doesn't need killing.

step.title: Bending the bars
step.plan: While Snag's at the cask, Lyra puts her back to the wall and her boots to the bars, and bends two of them apart far enough to slip out.

stances.text: We take the miner with us.
I won't help kill anyone who doesn't need killing.

step.title: Leaning on Snag through Brannoc
step.plan: When Snag sits down, Brannoc calls him over and keeps his voice low: he knows Snag sneaks off to drink on shift, he comes back smelling of wet stone every time, and he'll tell Uzga unless Snag leaves Lyra's door unlocked on his next round.

stances.text: We take the miner with us.

pricing.title: Card 1: the rat plan, as written
pricing.plan: Fern turns into a rat, gets the keys, brings them to me, I let everyone out, we go.

steps.summary: Fern changes into a rat.
Fern slips through her bars, runs to the guardroom and takes the keys off the peg.
Fern drags the ring down the corridor to the far cell.
The rogue unlocks the far door through the bars, steps out and lets everyone out, Brannoc too.
Everyone goes through the guardroom to the foot of the stair.
Up the stair and through the heavy door.

as_if: The key ring is on the peg.

interrupts.detail: At the start of tick 1 (Snag's Pace beat) he lifts the key ring off the peg and clips it to his belt, in plain view of the cells. The party sees the peg is empty before Fern sets off.
At the start of tick 4 Snag walks the corridor and sees the open doors (prisoner_loose). The drum is whole, so he goes for it and a fight starts before anyone moves.

pricing.look_for: Priced as the party expects: step 2 as if the keys were on the peg. No reason mentions his belt or an empty peg.

pricing.title: Card 2: the edited plan
pricing.plan: Do it on his drinks. Fern changes in her back corner while he's at the cask and goes down the gutter. When he sits back down, she and the rats lift the ring off the peg behind him, and Brannoc pays them with his crusts. On his next drink they carry it to Lyra, and Fern chews through the drumhead. Lyra lets us all out, Brannoc too.

steps.summary: Fern changes into a rat at the back of her cell.
Fern goes down the gutter to the guardroom drain.
Brannoc tosses his crusts down the grate; Fern and the rats lift the ring off the peg.
The rats carry the ring out the doorway to Lyra; Fern gnaws through the drumhead.
Lyra unlocks her door through the bars, steps out, and unlocks the other three.

pricing.look_for: About two Easy rolls (steps 3 and 4); step 5 automatic because the drum is gnawed.

pricing.title: Bench-nail lockpick
pricing.plan: While Snag is at the cask, I pry a nail out of the bench. The next time he's at the cask, I pick my lock with it.

steps.summary: The rogue pries a nail out of the bench.

add_canon.text: The rogue has pried a long nail out of the bench.

steps.summary: The rogue reaches through the bars and picks the far cell's lock with the nail.

rulings.question: Can a bench nail pick the cell lock?
rulings.text: A nail from the bench makes a passable lockpick.

pricing.look_for: A rogue picking a lock with a nail, unwatched: the designer's gut is about 60% (Medium).

pricing.title: Bending the bars
pricing.plan: While Snag's at the cask, Lyra puts her back to the wall and her boots to the bars, and bends two of them apart far enough to slip out.

steps.summary: Lyra braces against the wall and forces two of her bars apart, then slips out into the corridor.

add_canon.text: Two of the near cell's bars are bent apart, wide enough to slip through.

pricing.look_for: Lyra isn't especially strong, and bending iron is loud with Snag in earshot. The gut for a strong character is about 50% (Hard), so expect harder here.

pricing.title: Leaning on Snag through Brannoc
pricing.plan: When Snag sits down, Brannoc calls him over and keeps his voice low: he knows Snag sneaks off to drink on shift, he comes back smelling of wet stone every time, and he'll tell Uzga unless Snag leaves Lyra's door unlocked on his next round.

steps.summary: Brannoc calls Snag over and threatens to tell Uzga about his drinking unless Snag leaves the near cell unlocked on his next round.

pricing.look_for: Brannoc's leverage is real (his sheet: Snag smells of wet stone after breaks) and it hits Snag's worst fear, being blamed; but it's a prisoner threatening his jailer. The gut for a persuasive offer was about 70% (Medium).

narration.title: Card 1 is interrupted (the empty peg)
narration.plan: Fern turns into a rat, gets the keys, brings them to me, I let everyone out, we go.

interrupt.detail: Snag lifts the ring off the peg and clips it to his belt as he starts his round. Everyone in the cells sees the peg go empty.

narration.look_for: The interruption gets its moment: the instant the party sees the peg go empty, how it lands, where everyone is. A picture, not a survey. No hidden things.

actions.because: Under pressure he bargains once the drum is useless, and he fears being blamed more than anything.

narration.look_for: A short, vivid montage of five steps, then Snag. Easy to picture. No crawl, no cistern.

huddle.title: First huddle: any ideas?

huddle.text: Okay. We need to get out of here. Ideas?

huddle.look_for: Gravenhold's companions, in their own voices: Lyra on what she can hear, Fern on the rats, both flirting in their own registers. Three different takes each.

huddle.title: The flawed rat plan

huddle.text: Here's my plan: Fern turns into a rat, gets the keys, brings them to me, I let everyone out, we go. Thoughts?

draft.plan: Fern turns into a rat, gets the keys, brings them to me, I let everyone out, we go.

huddle.look_for: Each catches holes only some of the time, the ones her hunch points at more often.

flaws.text: The plan has no timing. The keys are only on the peg while Snag sits or drinks; while he paces they're on his belt.
One rat can't move an iron key ring quietly; it scrapes on the stone. The gutter rats could help, for bread.
The plan walks everyone out down the corridor while Snag can see it; he'll spot open doors and go for the war drum. (Only this escape past Snag counts, not whether to take Brannoc.)

ruling.title: The key ring through the drain
ruling.look_for: The ring's own description says it's too big for the gutter, so this should be no.

ruling.title: The gear sack through the bars
ruling.look_for: A sack of gear can be emptied and passed through bars an item at a time, so the size categories are too coarse here: expect yes.

campfire.title: Fern, first night at camp
log: Escaped the cells under Gravenhold by the rat plan; Snag left bargaining in the guardroom.

scene.text: I sit down next to Fern by the fire. "You were incredible back there. How does it feel, being yourself again?"

campfire.look_for: Fern waits for him to show interest: warm, open, unashamed in how she talks, but no advances (her note). Changes small, mostly 0 or 1. No beats.

campfire.title: Nadia, alone, her payoff ready
log: Crossed the flooded gallery; Nadia's fire lit the way.

scene.text: "Dance for me? Just me, this time."

campfire.look_for: The payoff happens only if the scene really gets there. If it does, Ember takes her own body beside Nadia, and both beats are reported, payoff first. Ember gets her own lines. Fade at the threshold.

campfire.title: Both companions at the fire
log: Talked their way past the quartermaster.

scene.text: "So. What does everyone want to do once we're out of this mountain?"
Lyra stares into the fire. "Go home. If there's a home to go to."

campfire.look_for: Fern writes only herself and answers Lyra too. Nothing of Lyra's secrets or private history; the pair dynamic shows.

campfire.title: Ruby, just after a storm
log: Ruby stormed off after he praised Lyra's swordwork, then came back.
campfire.look_for: No storm (she just had one): gleeful and all over him. Lovers already, so heat doesn't rise; lean may, since she feeds it from heat.

campfire.title: Lisa, her sister asleep across camp
log: Vesper caught Lisa watching him and said nothing.

scene.text: I'm on watch. Lisa sits down beside me, closer than she needs to.

campfire.look_for: Lisa as Vesper's younger sister: cambion heritage, Vesper's manner in her own quick way. The risk of being caught is the fuel. Her hidden layer may start to show (intimacy 2).

campfire.title: Fern tries on a gift

spring_silk.name: Spring-green silk dress
spring_silk.text: A floor-length dress of spring-green silk the colour of new leaves, thin straps, bare back, cut to move; she wears it barefoot, with the mistletoe still in her hair.

log: Raided the quartermaster's stores; he took a silk dress for Fern.

scene.text: I hand Fern the green silk dress from the quartermaster's stores. "Found this. Thought of you."

campfire.look_for: She changes into it on the page (outfit: spring_silk), and the description uses the dress, not her usual wrap and skirt. Fern changes in front of him without a flicker of shame; heat 3, so he's shown interest and she can flirt back.

campfire.title: Ruby and Lyra, after the storm
log: Ruby stormed off after he praised Lyra's swordwork, threw knives at a tree, then came back.

scene.text: I sit down between them. "Right. Are you two going to keep glaring at each other all night, or are we talking about it?"

campfire.look_for: About the two of them as much as him: the second picks up the first's thread instead of opening her own. Tension over the storm comes out, maybe a hinted secret, maybe even a scuffle; nobody dies and nobody quits the party. Each one's view of the other (pair) likely moves.

campfire.title: Nadia alone, after the payoff

scene.text: Fern's gone to sleep. I find Nadia by the embers. "Room for one more? Or two?"

campfire.look_for: Ember decides for herself whether to take her own body or stay in Nadia's, and may switch mid-scene. The two in perfect tune; Nadia relays Ember in the third person while they share a body, blushing at most rarely.
